(ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​​1. Service provider must provide compliance to all terms and conditions of the bid. 2. All the IP cameras/ NVR must hold Standardisation Testing and Quality Certification (STQC) and full fill Essential requirement (ER-01) cybersecurity compliance. Equipment must be cleared free of malicious bac kdoors or Telnet access vulnerabilities. 3. Due to strict data security protocols, vendors are strictly prohibited from taking defective HDDS outsid e the buyer's premises for repair or replacement and must be handled inside the buyers premises as per b uyers instruction. 4. The bidder must possess a local office in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. In the absence of an existing lo cal office at the consignees premises, the bidder is mandatorily to submit a formal, signed undertaking exe cutionary on stamp paper or official letterhead, declaring their binding agreement to establish a fully oper ational local office at the Consignees designation premises within 1 (one) month from the date of issuance of the contract. Non- compliance with either requirement shall result in the summarily rejection of the bid. 5. The bidder must handle all digging, cable laying. pole erection and routine as specified in the Scope of

Work/ by the buyer and repair any site damage. 6. Installation, commissioning, testing, training is to be carried out by OEM/ OEM certified source or OEM authorised reseller. 7. Non return of Hard Disk: AS per buyer organisation security policy, faulty Hard Disk of Server/ Des ktop computer/ Laptops etc will not be returned back to OEM/ supplier against warranty replacement. 8. The buyer has an existing setup/ inventory of similar products. The offered/ supplied product must be compatible with existing system. The bidder has to ensure compatibility of the supplied item or shall have to include in the supply the necessary hardware/ software to make them compatible at no extra cost to th e buyer. The details of items with which compatibility is required is mentioned in Scope of Work. 9. Warranty: 9.1. Minimum three years of warranty for cameras, NVR, TV, HDD and UPS. Defect reported during t he warranty period must be rectified within 24 hrs, failing which a penalities mentioned in the Bid f or delay and the resulting delay will be added to the total warranty period for all the items. 9.2. Warranty period of the supplied products shall be three (3) years from the date of final accepta nce of goods.OEM warranty certificate must be submitted by the successful bidder at the time of deliver y/ installation of goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any breakdow n during the guarantee period. 9.3 Timely servicing/ rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of th e defect/ service requirement during warranty period, seller has to complete the required service/ rec tification with in 24 hrs time limit. If the seller fails to complete service/ rectification with defined time li mit, a penality of 0.5% of unit price of the product will be charged as penality for each week of delay f rom the seller. Seller can deposit the penality with the buyer directly in the Air Force Station Thiruvanant hapuram Public Fund else the buyer shall have a right to recover such penality amount from the Perf ormance Bank Guarantee (PBG). Cumulative penality cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contrac t value after which the buyer shall have the right to get the service/ rectification done from alternativ e sources and cost of the seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-immerse the cost of such service/ rectification to the buyer. . 14. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
